name: CVK Maden Isletmeleri Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S.
summary: CVK Maden Isletmeleri Sanayi ve Ticaret AS is a Turkey-based company engaged in mining and mining-related operations. The company's main activities involve the mining, processing, and wholesaling of chrome, lead, zinc, copper, and magnesite ores. It produces and exports materials such as concentrated and lump chromite ore and concentrated lead, which are extracted from its own licensed mining areas in Turkey. The company also actively conducts exploration and survey activities on its licensed lands.
